description: This file defines protocols, message structures, enums, and data models for the OpenClaw Protocol within a Swift-based codebase. It includes message framing, error handling, agent management, session operations, configuration, and other communication-related data structures used for interfacing with the OpenClaw system.

classes.name: ErrorCode
classes.description: Enumeration of possible error codes within the protocol, conforming to String and Codable for seamless serialization.

classes.name: ConnectParams
classes.description: Structure representing connection parameters used during protocol handshake, including protocol version, client info, capabilities, permissions, and other connection metadata.

classes.name: HelloOk
classes.description: Represents the server's successful handshake response with protocol version, server features, snapshot, and policy details.

classes.name: RequestFrame
classes.description: Generic structure representing a request message frame with method and optional parameters.

classes.name: ResponseFrame
classes.description: Represents a response to a request, indicating success or failure, with payload or error details.

classes.name: EventFrame
classes.description: Structure for conveying asynchronous events with associated payload and sequence information.

classes.name: PresenceEntry
classes.description: Modeling user presence information with identification, status, tags, and timestamps.

classes.name: StateVersion
classes.description: Versioning info for presence and health states.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: Current system snapshot, including presence entries, health, state version, and other status info.

classes.name: ErrorShape
classes.description: Standard error message shape with code, message, optional details, and retry info.

classes.name: AgentEvent
classes.description: Represents an agent-related event with run ID, sequence number, stream, timestamp, and data payload.

classes.name: SendParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending a message, including recipient, message content, media, channels, and idempotency.

classes.name: PollParams
classes.description: Parameters for creating a poll, including question, options, duration, and privacy settings.

classes.name: AgentParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending a message to an agent, including message content, agent and session IDs, and attachments.

classes.name: AgentIdentityParams
classes.description: Identification parameters for an agent, including agent ID and session key.

classes.name: AgentIdentityResult
classes.description: Result data for an agent identity request, including agent id, name, avatar, and emoji.

classes.name: AgentWaitParams
classes.description: Parameters to wait for an agent run, including run ID and timeout.

classes.name: WakeParams
classes.description: Parameters used for waking or activating a node with mode and text.

classes.name: NodePairRequestParams
classes.description: Parameters for initiating or requesting pairing of nodes, including node ID, display name, platform, and capabilities.

classes.name: NodePairApproveParams
classes.description: Parameters for approving a node pairing request by request ID.

classes.name: NodePairRejectParams
classes.description: Parameters for rejecting a node pairing request.

classes.name: NodePairVerifyParams
classes.description: Parameters for verifying a node with node ID and token.

classes.name: NodeRenameParams
classes.description: Parameters for renaming a node with node ID and display name.

classes.name: NodeInvokeParams
classes.description: Parameters for invoking a command on a node, including command and optional parameters.

classes.name: NodeInvokeResultParams
classes.description: Results of a node invocation, including status, payload, and error info.

classes.name: NodeEventParams
classes.description: Parameters for emitting events from nodes.

classes.name: PushTestParams
classes.description: Parameters for testing push notifications to a node.

classes.name: PushTestResult
classes.description: Results of push notification tests including status, reason, and errors.

classes.name: SecretsResolveParams
classes.description: Parameters to resolve secrets with command name and target IDs.

classes.name: SecretsResolveAssignment
classes.description: Details of secret assignments including path and value.

classes.name: SecretsResolveResult
classes.description: Outcome of secret resolution including assignments and diagnostics.

classes.name: SessionsListParams
classes.description: Parameters for listing sessions with filters such as limit, state, agent ID, etc.

classes.name: SessionsCreateParams
classes.description: Parameters for creating a session, including key, agent ID, label, model, and parent session info.

classes.name: SessionsSendParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending messages within sessions, including message, thinking, attachments, etc.

classes.name: ConfigGetParams
classes.description: Parameters for retrieving configuration.

classes.name: ConfigSetParams
classes.description: Parameters for setting configuration raw data and base hash.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaResponse
classes.description: Schema information including UI hints, version, and generation timestamp.

classes.name: WizardStartParams
classes.description: Parameters to start a wizard session with mode and workspace.

classes.name: WizardStep
classes.description: Definition of a wizard step including prompts, options, and executors.

classes.name: WizardNextResult
classes.description: Result after a wizard step, including completion status, next step, and errors.

classes.name: TalkSpeakParams
classes.description: Parameters for text-to-speech, including voice, model, speed, and other voice characteristics.

classes.name: ChannelsStatusParams
classes.description: Parameters to probe channels with optional timeout.

classes.name: AgentSummary
classes.description: Summary information about an agent including ID, name, identity, workspace, and model.

classes.name: AgentsCreateParams
classes.description: Parameters for creating a new agent with name, workspace, and optional emoji/avatar.

classes.name: AgentsFileEntry
classes.description: Representation of an agent's file with metadata and content.

classes.name: AgentsFilesListParams
classes.description: Parameters for listing agent files by agent ID.

classes.name: AgentsFilesGetParams
classes.description: Parameters for retrieving a specific agent file.

classes.name: AgentsFilesSetParams
classes.description: Parameters for setting or updating an agent file.

classes.name: AgentsListParams
classes.description: Parameters for listing all agents.

classes.name: ModelChoice
classes.description: Model selection options including ID, name, provider, and features.

classes.name: AgentsListResult
classes.description: Result object containing an array of AgentSummary.

classes.name: GatewayFrame
classes.description: Enum representing different types of message frames: request, response, event, or unknown, used to frame protocol messages.
